preconditions: Exact application identity and empty session
Private input copy hash matches recovered source
One configuration; blank geometry; no active sketch
Standard datums and passive folders only
No existing modeling features, external references, equations or macro features
Observed reference plane at origin with positive Z normal

change.binding: Own uniquely named extrusion, verified type, lineage, configuration and prior depth

mandatoryChecks: Exactly one solid and zero sheet bodies
Mass properties array has at least12 finite values
Depth, volume, area and center within declared tolerances
Save succeeds with zero errors and warnings, correct path and clean document
Reopened candidate matches all native and geometric predicates
Original recovery and baseline files retain exact hashes
Final document count zero and original application process retained
limitations: Density1 is a calculation input, not material evidence
No assembly operations, persistent topology qualification, worker isolation or release approval
